topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: In the clearing beyond the usual paths, where the earth whispers more softly, a scent carries not of root or leaf, but of something richer, deeper. It coils through the air, mingling with the usual green, a hint of the unexpected. It speaks of hidden treasures, of secrets the forest protects. I move with careful steps, letting this newness settle over me, neither chasing nor fleeing. The world pulsates with more than survival here; it is a place of layers, some bared by the wind, others concealed by shadows. I am not troubled by this discovery; instead, I am drawn to understand, to feel the pulse of this place without urgency, only a quiet, deliberate curiosity.
